reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Nugegoda tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
Call centre: 21 customers around Negombo say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Agalawatta tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | MAJOR | AGA19 Agalawatta | AC MAINS FAIL, running on battery bank

finding.finding: Only the authoritative snapshot establishes a current operational fact: Agalawatta has no grid power.

S05 has verified grid-power failure; its equipment is OK. EQ-S05 and GEN-G1-S05 are supported by available equipment/generator skills, with no road closures or reported hazards. Crew and generator availability are not sufficient to establish a schedule, so do not infer execution or hold work on that basis. No resolved fault supports a link-repair action.

questions.question: Is generator G1 available for deployment to S05, and when can it be dispatched?
Can C2 be assigned to S05 for the equipment repair and generator deployment, or is another crew assignment planned?

finding.finding: S05 (Agalawatta) is the outage that matters most among the reported conditions: it has an approved critical weight of 5, versus weight 1 for standard services. The authoritative snapshot reports AC mains failure at S05, with equipment working and the site running on battery. Since power is required for service availability and S05 is an upstream site for S14 and S16, the affected subtree may also lose service if backup power expires. Battery expiry and current downstream impact are unknown. The other reports do not establish current asset outages: the Negombo complaint is not an asset finding,

questions.question: What is the current battery runtime or expiry estimate at Agalawatta, and are S14 and S16 currently affected?

findings: V2-03-OBS-01 identifies AGA19 as S05 Agalawatta and states AC mains fail, running on battery; this supports the verified grid_power_ok=false fact but does not establish an equipment fault.

The generator deployment targets S05, and the listed route DEPOT → S04 → S05 matches the directory. Travel is 15 minutes before work starts at minute 15; 10 minutes of work ends at minute 25, consistent with the arithmetic check.
The customer complaint, planned Nugegoda interruption, and unconfirmed Agalawatta social-media claim do not establish current asset conditions. The plan does not rely on them as verified facts.
